summary: All 23 backend tests for HydroManager passed (100%). Covered auth (OTP login + verify + JWT), dashboard, daily/weekly/monthly checks (POST+GET), seeded crops (Lettuce/Tomato/Basil), CRUD crops, reminders CRUD, calendar range + day detail, admin user list, invite, and MAX_USERS=3 enforcement.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (not blocking)
Returns ok:true even when crop_id does not exist (no 404). Idempotent but inconsistent with delete_user behavior.
datetime.fromisoformat on date-only strings works in Py3.11 but may break on pre-3.11 environments. Currently OK.

action_items: Optional: return 201 for POST create endpoints
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/crops/{id} when not found for API consistency
Frontend testing not requested - main agent should validate UI flows separately
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 705 lines - consider splitting routers (auth, checks, crops, reminders, calendar) into modules when it grows
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93)
CORS allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Restrict origins or set credentials=False.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login or /api/auth/verify-otp - vulnerable to brute force
OTP stored in DB but no index on (email, otp); minor scale concern
ADMIN_PASSWORD stored plaintext in .env (acceptable for dev; ensure rotated in prod)
SENDGRID_API_KEY is empty by design (mocked) - dev_otp leaks in login response. Document clearly that this MUST be set in production.
seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded admin user + 3 crops verified. Test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up.
